# Elf

> Elf is a dark-only design system for Vue 3 and Nuxt 4, built on Reka UI and Tailwind CSS v4, with two themes: elf (violet, rounded) and novatron (gold on obsidian, sharp corners).

Elf is source-distributed: install from a pinned GitHub tag (currently v0.1.0). All Vue components use the `Elf` prefix. Use Bun for every command.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/?path=/docs/guide-getting-started--docs): install in a Nuxt 4 app
- [Theming](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/?path=/docs/guide-theming--docs): tokens, data-theme, creating a theme
- [Using without Nuxt](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/?path=/docs/guide-using-without-nuxt--docs): Vite and Vue setup
- [Registry](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/?path=/docs/guide-registry--docs): copy components with the shadcn-vue CLI
- [Button](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/?path=/docs/components-button--docs): Triggers an action. Renders a native button; use as-child to render a link or other element.
- [Input](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/?path=/docs/components-input--docs): Single-line text input with v-model. A native input: all native attributes fall through.
- [Badge](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/?path=/docs/components-badge--docs): Small pill for status and labels. Static text unless rendered as a link or button with as-child.
- [Card](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/?path=/docs/components-card--docs): Container for grouped content, composed from parts.
- [Dialog](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/?path=/docs/components-dialog--docs): Accessible modal dialog on Reka UI: focus trap, Escape to close, focus restore.
- [Tabs](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/?path=/docs/components-tabs--docs): Switch between related views. Roving focus and arrow-key navigation on Reka UI.

## Reference

- [Documentation site](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/): Storybook with every component, props and guides
- [Repository](https://github.com/xouyi/elf): source, issues, releases
- [Example Nuxt app](https://github.com/xouyi/elf/tree/main/examples/nuxt-demo): realistic consumer installed from a GitHub tag
- [Registry item index](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/r/registry.json): shadcn-vue registry (copy components into your project)
- [llms-full.txt](https://xouyi.github.io/elf/llms-full.txt): complete reference for AI assistants

## Rules

- Use Elf components (ElfButton, ElfInput, ElfBadge, ElfCard, ElfDialog, ElfTabs) instead of hand-rolling buttons, inputs, badges, cards, dialogs or tabs.
- Choose appearance with props (variant, size), not custom classes or inline styles.
- Style with theme tokens (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, border-border), never hard-coded colors (no #hex, no bg-violet-500).
- Elf is dark only: do not add light-mode styles or dark: variants.
- Do not override border radius with arbitrary values; radii derive from the theme (novatron is sharp, 0px).
- Components are auto-imported in Nuxt with the Elf prefix; outside Nuxt import them from "@elf/ui".
- Always label inputs (label for= or aria-label) and give icon-only buttons an aria-label.
- Dialogs need a title and description; tabs lists need an aria-label.
- Keep exactly one primary (default variant) button per view; use destructive only for irreversible actions.
- Install from a pinned GitHub tag (github:xouyi/elf#vX.Y.Z); typescript must be installed in the consumer project.
- Use Bun for all package commands (bun add, bun run, bunx), never npm, pnpm or yarn.
